objective: Switch between List and Board views on Linear.
notes: Ensure you are logged into your Linear account.

steps.title: Navigate to the Projects Section
steps.action: Click on the 'Projects' tab in the sidebar.

steps.title: Locate the View Toggle
steps.action: Find the view toggle button at the top right of the Projects section.
steps.expected_result: The view toggle button is visible.

steps.title: Switch to Board View
steps.action: Click on the view toggle button and select 'Board'.
steps.expected_result: The view changes to Board view.

steps.title: Switch to List View
steps.action: Click on the view toggle button again and select 'List'.
steps.expected_result: The view changes to List view.

success_criteria: User can successfully switch to Board view.
User can successfully switch back to List view.
